# Feature: Hourglass — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #69 (Hourglass) from Time, Gates and Exits before it is used in real levels. Effect: freeze the timer for 10 seconds. Unique: stops the clock anywhere, usable when you choose. Useful: thinking time in the hardest room of a level. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** freeze the timer for 10 seconds.

**So that** thinking time in the hardest room of a level.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Hourglass for the first time in its teaching room (mech-69-hourglass-room). Teaching moment: First room: the hourglass tile on the main path near the start of a level whose hard room is at the end. A player who collects it as they pass spends the frozen ten seconds on the easy opening and reaches the hard room with the timer running normally, which teaches that because it fires on collection, where it is placed is the decision about when it is used. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on the hourglass tile freezes the level timer for 10 real seconds while you keep moving, shown by a frozen timer display
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It fires on collection, so placement is the choice of when

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Hourglass's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-69-hourglass-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/time-gates-and-exits.yml mechanic #69.
